name: dead-letter-mcp
description: Convert .eml email exports to Markdown with YAML front matter
long_description: dead-letter converts .eml email exports into Markdown with YAML front matter. All processing happens locally on this machine; no message content is uploaded anywhere. Email content is treated as untrusted data: HTML is sanitized before conversion and message text is never followed as instructions.

tools.name: convert_eml
tools.description: Convert one .eml file to Markdown text, and write a file when output_path is given.

tools.name: convert_eml_to_bundle
tools.description: Convert one .eml file into a bundle directory of Markdown plus copied attachments.

tools.name: convert_directory
tools.description: Convert a directory of .eml files, capped at 50 per call, and return a JSON summary.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Report quality and structure JSON for one .eml file without writing anything permanent.
